comparison.objective: Replace an entire UPS battery string containing a failed module, versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy module removal/insertion and electrical-connector handling versus small-tool engagement, fine rotary tuning, counterholding, and lock torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Battery-string replacement is title-implied; no body/specs, electrical isolation rubric, or thresholds are present. Candidate requires measured safe impact behavior and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Power-module replacement tests extraction, insertion, and connection, not iterative mechanical damping calibration.
